Hugging Face Trending Models Digest 2026-09-03

Source: Hugging Face Hub | 30 models | Generated: 2026-09-03 01:54 UTC

Hugging Face Trending Models Digest | September 3, 2026

1. Today's Highlights

As of September 3, 2026, the Qwen3.8 family dominates Hugging Face’s weekly trending charts, with the flagship Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B multimodal model boasting the highest weekly likes (13,694) of any entry and spawning over a dozen community fine-tunes and quantizations. Video generation models see explosive traction, with MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3 and Lightricks/LTX-2.5 both notching millions of downloads and thousands of weekly likes. The zai-org GLM-5.3 lineup makes a strong debut, with the Flash multimodal variant securing 1,968 weekly likes and the base MoE text model earning 1,518 likes. Uncensored and quantized (GGUF, FP8, MLX) community variants of top foundation models account for over 40% of the top 30 trending list, reflecting high demand for edge-deployable, unrestricted model access.

2. Trending Models

Organized by category, sorted by weekly likes descending within each group

🧠 Language Models (LLMs, chat models, instruction-tuned)

  • openai-community/gpt2
    Author: openai-community | Likes: 3,534 | Downloads: 14,290,101
    The iconic foundational 124M-parameter text generation model, trending due to its enduring use as a baseline for LLM research and lightweight fine-tuning.
  • zai-org/GLM-5.3
    Author: zai-org | Likes: 1,518 | Downloads: 94,403
    A Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) text generation LLM from the GLM-5.3 family, trending for its strong conversational performance and DSA-optimized efficient MoE architecture.
  • tencent/Hy4-preview
    Author: tencent | Likes: 400 | Downloads: 3,516
    Preview release of Tencent’s 4th-generation Hunyuan text LLM, trending as a new open-weight entry from a major Chinese technology developer.
  • pipecat-ai/phonellm-alpha-1
    Author: pipecat-ai | Likes: 199 | Downloads: 6,813
    Alpha-stage conversational LLM optimized for telephony and voice interaction workflows, trending for its niche focus on real-time voice use cases.
  • XHToken/Spark-X2.5-4B
    Author: XHToken | Likes: 123 | Downloads: 429
    A 4B-parameter lightweight text generation LLM from the Spark series, trending for its small footprint and suitability for edge deployment.

🎨 Multimodal & Generation (image, video, audio, text-to-X)

  • Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
    Author: Qwen | Likes: 13,694 | Downloads: 4,960,483
    The 27B-parameter flagship multimodal model of the Qwen3.8 series, trending as the highest-liked new foundation model this week with industry-leading image-text performance.
  • MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3
    Author: MiniMaxAI | Likes: 4,812 | Downloads: 5,532,597
    A high-performance image-text-to-video generation model, trending as the most downloaded new release this week with cinematic-quality output.
  • Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
    Author: Qwen | Likes: 4,740 | Downloads: 207,941
    Experimental fast multimodal model from the Qwen3.8 line, trending for its low-latency image-text understanding and conversational capabilities.
  • Lightricks/LTX-2.5
    Author: Lightricks | Likes: 2,577 | Downloads: 1,232,274
    A state-of-the-art image-to-video generation model supporting text and video inputs, trending for its high-quality output and fast inference.
  • zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash
    Author: zai-org | Likes: 1,968 | Downloads: 441,348
    A fast, lightweight multimodal (image-text-to-text) model from the GLM-5.3 family, trending for its balanced speed and conversational multimodal performance.
  • deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp
    Author: deepseek-ai | Likes: 507 | Downloads: 17,893
    Experimental fast vision-language model from DeepSeek’s V4 lineup, trending as a new entry in the high-speed multimodal space.
  • BreezeBlue/Breeze-TTS-2
    Author: BreezeBlue | Likes: 357 | Downloads: 3,086
    Second-generation text-to-speech model from BreezeBlue, trending for its natural-sounding voice generation and transformer-based architecture.
  • FastVideo/FastVideo-FastH3-4-step-Preview-v1-VSA-DataFree
    Author: FastVideo | Likes: 250 | Downloads: 0
    A 4-step fast text-to-video preview model optimized for speed, trending for its ultra-fast inference and data-free training approach.

🔧 Specialized Models (code, math, medical, embeddings)

  • sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2
    Author: sentence-transformers | Likes: 5,393 | Downloads: 250,280,836
    The de facto standard lightweight sentence embedding model, trending due to its massive ongoing adoption in RAG, semantic search, and text classification workflows.
  • google-bert/bert-base-uncased
    Author: google-bert | Likes: 2,861 | Downloads: 63,694,017
    The foundational BERT base model for masked language modeling, trending for its persistent use as a baseline for NLP fine-tuning tasks across industries.
  • google/timesfm-3.0-pytorch
    Author: google | Likes: 298 | Downloads: 0
    Third-generation time-series forecasting model from Google, trending as a major update to the popular TimesFM series for predictive analytics use cases.

📦 Fine-tunes & Quantizations (community fine-tunes, GGUF, AWQ)

  • unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF
    Author: unsloth | Likes: 3,393 | Downloads: 9,354,057
    Official Unsloth GGUF quantization of Qwen3.8-27B, trending as the highest-downloaded model in the top 30, optimized for fast edge and local deployment.
  • orcarouter/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-FP8
    Author: orcarouter | Likes: 1,371 | Downloads: 316,128
    FP8-precision uncensored fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B multimodal model, trending for its balance of speed, size, and unrestricted conversational capability.
  • orcarouter/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-MLX
    Author: orcarouter | Likes: 1,274 | Downloads: 121,028
    MLX-optimized uncensored fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B, trending for its native support for Apple Silicon local deployment.
  • OBLITERATUS/Qwen3.8-27B-OBLITERATED
    Author: OBLITERATUS | Likes: 1,026 | Downloads: 805,791
    An abliterated (alignment-removed) fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B, trending for its unrestricted output and support for MLX and GGUF formats.
  • JonathanColetti/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-GGUF
    Author: JonathanColetti | Likes: 919 | Downloads: 2,143,289
    Uncensored GGUF quantization of Qwen3.8-27B with MTP support, trending for its popularity among local LLM users seeking unrestricted access.
  • HauhauCS/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-HauhauCS-Aggressive-MTP-GGUF
    Author: HauhauCS | Likes: 871 | Downloads: 1,276,092
    Aggressively uncensored MTP-optimized GGUF quant of Qwen3.8-27B, trending for its unrestricted multimodal output and high download volume.
  • unsloth/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GGUF
    Author: unsloth | Likes: 727 | Downloads: 431,339
    Unsloth’s GGUF quant of the fast Qwen3.8-Flash-Next multimodal model, trending for low-latency local multimodal deployment.
  • orcarouter/Qwen3.8-27B-Uncensored-GGUF
    Author: orcarouter | Likes: 659 | Downloads: 254,529
    Standard GGUF uncensored fine-tune of Qwen3.8-27B, trending as a go-to option for unrestricted local multimodal use.
  • Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental
    Author: Kijai | Likes: 397 | Downloads: 0
    Experimental community variant of MiniMax-H3 video generation model, trending for its potential improvements to the base model’s output quality.
  • unsloth/GLM-5.3-Flash-GGUF
    Author: unsloth | Likes: 338 | Downloads: 63,718
    Unsloth GGUF quantization of GLM-5.3-Flash, trending for enabling fast local deployment of the new GLM multimodal model.
  • orcarouter/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Uncensored-GGUF
    Author: orcarouter | Likes: 194 | Downloads: 64,325
    Uncensored GGUF quant of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, trending for fast, unrestricted local multimodal inference.
  • peculiar-ragdoll/Tiel-Coder-35B-A3B-GGUF
    Author: peculiar-ragdoll | Likes: 194 | Downloads: 130,086
    A code-specialized 35B MoE GGUF model based on Qwen3.5 MoE architecture, trending for its strong coding performance and efficient MoE design for local deployment.
  • ISTA-DASLab/Qwen3.8-27B-GSQ-RCO-GGUF
    Author: ISTA-DASLab | Likes: 175 | Downloads: 56,208
    Research-grade GGUF quantization of Qwen3.8-27B using GSQ-RCO mixed-precision methods, trending for its novel quantization technique that preserves performance at smaller sizes.
  • orcarouter/GLM-5.3-Flash-Uncensored-FP8
    Author: orcarouter | Likes: 152 | Downloads: 2,576
    FP8 uncensored fine-tune of GLM-5.3-Flash, trending as one of the first community uncensored variants of the new GLM-5.3 model.

3. Ecosystem Signal

The Qwen3.8 family is the clear momentum leader in the open-weight ecosystem, with 12 of the top 30 trending models being official releases or community derivatives of Qwen3.8 variants, driven by its strong multimodal performance and broad compatibility with fine-tuning and quantization tools. The newly launched GLM-5.3 lineup from zai-org is also gaining fast traction, with four entries in the top 30 spanning official releases and early community variants. Open-weight models fully dominate the trending list, with no proprietary API-only models appearing, underscoring the ongoing shift toward accessible, modifiable foundation models among developers. Community activity is heavily focused on two high-demand use cases: quantization (GGUF, FP8, MLX formats make up over 40% of trending entries) for local and edge deployment, and uncensored/abliterated fine-tunes, which account for the majority of community Qwen3.8 and GLM-5.3 variants, reflecting strong user appetite for unrestricted model access.

4. Worth Exploring

  1. Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
    As the highest-liked new foundation model of the week with industry-leading multimodal performance, Qwen3.8-27B has quickly become the new baseline for open-weight image-text models. Its massive ecosystem of community fine-tunes, quantizations, and tooling makes it suitable for nearly any use case, from enterprise RAG with vision inputs to local deployment on consumer hardware.
  2. MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3
    The fastest-growing video generation model on the platform, MiniMax-H3 delivers cinematic-quality text/image-to-video output at a fraction of the cost of proprietary alternatives. It is ideal for developers building creative media tools, content generation pipelines, or researching advances in diffusion-based video synthesis.
  3. ISTA-DASLab/Qwen3.8-27B-GSQ-RCO-GGUF
    This research-grade quantization uses novel GSQ-RCO mixed-precision techniques to preserve near-base-model performance at significantly reduced file sizes, making it a must-study for teams working on efficient LLM deployment, edge AI, or quantization method research.
